goals.text: Till a tile with the shovel

visit.notice: Zoe is waiting outside your house.
lines: Oh, there you are! {player}, right? I've been watching the road since sunrise. I'm Zoe, I run the flower stall by the square.
Welcome to the valley! Everyone's been wondering who'd take the old farm. Granny said someone with strong hands.
And look at that, strong hands!
Right, a proper tour! The shop is that way, Jonas runs it, he's new too, so you'll get along.
The shipping box by your gate buys whatever you grow.
And the farmhouse behind you has your bed. Sleep when you're tired.
The day ends whether you like it or not, and you'll want your energy back.
These are cauliflower seeds. Five of them. Don't make that face, everyone starts with cauliflower. It's honest food.
Shovel to dig a patch, then a seed, then the watering can. Just one tile for now. I'll stand here and watch. I won't say anything.
...I'm going to say something. Go on!
Oh, {player}! Good, I found you. Well, you're easy to find. You're always in the field. That's good!
Forgive me, I should have said something sooner. You're the new one, we spoke the other day. I've been thinking about your farm.
I can help you with something. Not much. I'm not good with money myself, being a novelist. Novelists are famously poor.
It's practically a tradition.
But I do know how selling works here. Harvest a crop, carry it to the shipping box by your farm, and it pays you for whatever you put in.
Sell enough and you'll have some gold to grow on. Seeds, tools, maybe more one day. It's a good start. It's fine. It's a good start.
I'll leave you to it. Please don't feel rushed. Really. It's no trouble at all.

goals.text: Find wood in the old pen

missing_lines: Hmph. The barn needs fixing. Tom can do it, but not for free.
250 gold and five good pieces of wood. There's plenty of rotten boards lying around the old pen.
Bring it all to me. Don't waste my time.
done_lines: Tom! To work. Four days, no more.
Tom: Y-yes, Grandpa! I'll do my best.

on_complete.message: The barn is repaired! You got a cow.

visit.notice: Walter and Tom are at your door.
lines: Hmph. Farmer.
The barn's broken. You've seen it. Roof's half gone and the door hangs by a hinge.
Tom can fix it. I'll teach him as he goes. Hmph. It's time he did something big.
Tom: H-hello, {player}! Sorry. Grandpa made me come. I mean, I wanted to come. I just didn't know what to say.
Not for free. Materials cost. 250 gold, and five good pieces of wood.
There's rotten boards lying around the old pen. Most are useless. Some are still sound. Find five.
Tom: I could help look, but Grandpa says it's your barn, so... your wood. Sorry!
Bring it all to me. Not the boy, me. Four days once I have it. Do it right and you'll have a cow. Hmph. Don't get attached.

missing_lines: Oh, {player}. Could you do me a small favour? I need five common field flowers for my perfumes.
They grow loose in the meadows around the village. Bring them to me when you have them.
done_lines: You know, in the old days the village wore red mountain flowers in their hair at the spring festivals.
Nobody does anymore. Because of the old legend. ...Never mind. It's only an old story.

lines: {player}. Good. I was about to go and wait by your fence.
I need a favour. A small one. Five common field flowers. Not the garden kind. The loose ones, out in the meadows.
For perfume. I'm trying something with the pollen. It's slow. Everything is slow.
Pick them by hand. Don't dig them up. They should be whole.
Bring them to me when you have them. I'm home most days. ...Thank you. I mean it.

goals.text: Place the hive on grass near flowers

lines: {player}! There you are. You look awful. I mean that fondly. Farming suits you. I came all this way to talk about something important.
Tea. Honey Lemon Tea is my favourite, I told you. But the imported artificial honey they sell here has no flavour at all.
Sweet and flat, like a polite compliance form. But I have seen the native flowers growing all over this valley.
Real honey could be made here! You have a farm. I have memories to chase. Take this hive, I made it from spare boards.
Put it on grass, with plenty of flowers within five tiles. And when you have the first honey, bring it to me.
I want to see if it tastes like home... or at least better than it.
The festival is on Summer 15, {player}! I need 10 vegetables (at least two kinds), 3 milk and 4 honey, all from your farm.
Bring them as you get them, no need for one big trip. Still missing: {missing}.
Still missing: {missing}. We have until the end of Summer 12, {player}. I'm counting on you!
Still missing: {missing}. It's nearly too late, {player}. Please, tomorrow is the last day!
Today is the last day, {player}! Still missing: {missing}. Please hurry!

thanks_lines: Thank you, {player}! That helps so much.
done_lines: That's everything! Oh, {player}, the whole village will be so happy.
The honey goes on the feast table. It'll be the sweetest festival we've had in years!

reminders.text: Zoe: "The festival is coming. Don't forget the supplies!"
Zoe: "Only a few days left to bring the festival supplies."
Zoe: "Two days left for the festival list!"
Last day to bring Zoe the festival supplies!

on_complete.message: Festival supplied! The village is delighted. (+200 gold)

on_fail.message: You never really joined in. Trying to make friends here felt like a waste of time, so you packed your things and left.

visit.notice: Zoe is waiting outside your house.
lines: {player}! Big news, and I need you. The summer festival is in two weeks, on Summer 15!
Everyone in the village contributes. It's tradition, and it's how a newcomer becomes one of us.
From you, I need 10 vegetables, at least two different kinds. Three milk. And four honey. All from your own farm.
The honey will be served at the feast, so make it good!
Bring things whenever you have them, as many trips as you like. Just come to me.
The list has to be complete by the end of Summer 12. I'll remind you. I'll remind you a lot. Sorry in advance!
